pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit highly irregular, jagged polygonal geometries with sharp edge gradients. Patches on the mid-flank are medium-sized and densely packed, transitioning to smaller, more fragmented pixel clusters toward the posterior and upper hind limb.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light pelage pathways form a continuous topological graph with frequent tri-radiate and quadri-radiate junction nodes. Pathway thickness is non-uniform, appearing wider at the shoulder-neck junction and narrowing significantly between patches on the lower flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the visible upper neck displays a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette against the background, indicating a short, stiff hair texture with a relatively uniform height.
